The Dark Order's Ceremonial Hat of Extreme Vitriol
Piece:  Helm
Class:  Mage
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

The Dark Order's Ceremonial Hat of Extreme Vitriol is a mage helm.

This item is soulbound. 1st Edition Item Pack Exclusive. It is on Karl's holiday Well table when that look is on. The list is on Holiday Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Shadow Damage

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
